LoopActions.Hint: Hold CTRL to delete an entry

AutoEquip.Name: Equip Recommended Gear
AutoEquip.GearSourceHelp:
Vanilla - Uses Gear from Armory Chest Only
Gearsetter - Asks gearsetter, can move old items to inventory
Stylist - Uses your stylist settings
AutoEquip.MoveOldToInventoryHelp: Except for weapons, this will move the gear to be replaced to the inventory.
AutoEquip.MoveOldWeaponsToInventoryHelp: Weapons cannot be unequipped first (the main hand may never be empty), so the new weapon is equipped via swap and the old one is then moved from the weapon armoury to the inventory. Prevents the main-hand armoury from filling up during levelling.
AutoEquip.RequiresGearsetterOrStylist: * Items outside the armoury chest requires Gearsetter or Stylist plugin

Repair.Name: Repair Gear
Repair.SelfHelp: Will use DarkMatter to Self Repair (Requires Leveled Crafters!)
Repair.CityNpcHelp: Will use preferred repair npc to repair.
Repair.PreferredRepairNPCHelp: It's a good idea to match the Repair NPC with Summoning Bell and if possible Retire Location
Repair.NPCSearchHint: Start typing NPC or zone name to search

AutoRetainer.Name: AutoRetainer
AutoRetainer.PreferredSummoningBellHelp: No matter what location is chosen, if there is a summoning bell in the location you are in when this is invoked it will go there instead

PlaylistPreLoop.Name: Playlist Pre Loop
PlaylistPreLoop.Help: If in playlist mode, changes gear set to the first entry's specified gearset

PlaylistSwitchLoop.Name: Playlist Duty Switch
PlaylistSwitchLoop.Help: If in playlist mode, changes gear set to the next entry's specified gearset, and switches the active loop to the next playlist entry, if applicable

Armoire.Name: Armoire
Armoire.Help: Will entrust items to the armoire between loops

Glamour.Name: Glamour Chest
Glamour.Help: Will entrust items to the glamour chest between loops

Desynth.Name: Desynthing
Desynth.ItemLevelLimitHelp: Stops desynthesising an item once your desynthesis skill reaches the Item Level + this limit.
Desynth.ProtectGearsetterUpgrades: Protect Gearsetter upgrades from Auto Desynth
Desynth.ProtectGearsetterUpgradesHelp: Also protects items that Gearsetter recommends as an upgrade for any of your gearsets, even if they aren't equipped in one yet. Requires the Gearsetter plugin.

Coffers.Name: Opening Coffers
Coffers.Help: AutoDuty will open gear coffers (like paladin arms) between each loop
Coffers.UseBlacklistHelp: Option to disable some coffers from being opened automatically.
Coffers.CofferNameHint: Start typing coffer name to search

ConsumeItems.Name: Consume Items
ConsumeItems.AutoConsumeHelp: AutoDuty will consume these items on run and between each loop (if status does not exist)
ConsumeItems.IgnoreStatusHelp: AutoDuty will consume these items on run and between each loop every time (even if status does exists)
ConsumeItems.MinTimeRemainingHelp: If the status has less than this amount of time remaining (in minutes), it will consume these items
ConsumeItems.ItemNameHint: Start typing item name to search

Wait.Name: Wait
Wait.WaitOnPlugins: Waits on the specified plugins to be done with their actions
